run.command: node apps/cli/bin/nexgent.mjs run --project <tmp>/proj --task "Create a file named hello.md containing a level-1 heading 'Hello Nexgent' followed by one sentence describing what this project directory is for. Then read it back to confirm."

notes: reasoningTokens is 'unknown' on every request by design: the Messages API does not report thinking tokens separately (and thinking was off).

inputTokens excludes cache reads and cache writes; cache_creation_input_tokens is dropped by packages/llm/src/usage.ts, so request 1 of the run shows inputTokens 4 although the prompt was about 2.35k tokens. Cost cannot be computed exactly from the ledger.
